summary: Bogota Financial Corp. filed an 8-K disclosing its entry into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with GSL Savings Bank, whereby GSL will merge into Bogota Savings Bank. Consideration involves Bogota issuing additional common shares to its mutual holding company parent equal to GSL's fair value as determined by an independent appraiser; no per-share price or premium is stated. The boards of both parties unanimously approved the deal. The merger is expected to close in the second half of 2026, subject to regulatory and other customary conditions. Termination provisions include a $750k fee payable by GSL in certain circumstances. Watch for regulatory approval timeline and appraisal outcome.
